assets.name: travel-icons-sheet
assets.prompt:
Use case: icon-system. Asset type: iPhone travel journal application raster icon sprite sheet. Create exactly 36 distinct hand-painted ink icons in a perfectly regular 6-column by 6-row grid on genuinely transparent background. Image square, each equal cell, all icons centered, generous transparent gutter, no borders/grid, no text or labels. Consistent simple bold deep teal #164E50 rounded strokes with tiny warm ochre accents, elegant travel sketchbook aesthetic. Each icon readable at 24 points. No lettering, no shadows. Exact row-major subjects:
row 1: shorts play rectangle; explore compass; journeys suitcase; chats two speech bubbles; profile person bust; search magnifying glass.
row 2: add plus; back left arrow; close X; heart outline; comment bubble; bookmark.
row 3: share arrow out of tray; more horizontal three dots; location map pin; folded map; calendar; checkmark.
row 4: wallet; diamond gem; settings gear; edit pencil; camera; photo landscape.
row 5: send paper plane; group three people; push pin; muted bell; trash bin; report flag.
row 6: blocked user with slash; phone handset; video camera; refresh circular arrows; route dotted path; globe.
All cells have one icon only. Actual alpha transparency outside icon shapes, no checkerboard painting.
assets.processing: Six by six row-major equal-cell crop; alpha-bounds crop; aspect fit 144 by 144; centered on transparent 160 by 160 canvas. No icons redrawn.

No text, lettering, brands, logo, stamp words, interface or people. Polished editorial cover illustration, rich yet serene.

assets.name: icon-filter
assets.prompt: Create one finished raster icon asset for the Lulu travel journal iPhone app, on a genuinely transparent RGBA background. The FIRST reference image specifies the exact icon geometry: three HORIZONTAL PARALLEL STROKES of equal length, each stroke has one small outlined round slider knob set in the stroke, and the centers of the knobs are staggered from top to bottom at roughly 25%, 70%, 40% along the stroke. All three strokes start and end at the same horizontal position. The horizontal ink stops cleanly at the edges of each knob, leaving the hollow interior legible. The SECOND reference provides the aesthetic, a hand-painted travel-journal deep teal ink with a quiet warm-ochre accent. Use strong deep teal for all strokes and knob outlines, and a restrained cream or pale ochre center in the knobs, lightly textured watercolor ink with clean readable shapes. Center the whole 3-line symbol in a square, with even clear margin and the symbol spanning approximately 72% of the canvas width. Bold enough to render clearly at 27pt; rounded stroke caps. Exactly three circular knobs, one per line. No exterior outline, no gear, no tapered funnel bars, no words, no numbers, no labels, no shadows, no paper rectangle. Keep background transparent.
